notes: Levels are the current values on maplestorywiki.net (Night Lord and Night Walker pages list 10/30/60/100/200/260).

Older values disagree: en.wikibooks MapleStory/Jobs (search snippet only, not fetched) lists 3rd job at 70 and 4th at 120. These look like an older version; check the live client before relying on them.
StrategyWiki Job Advancements (strategywiki.org) returned a Cloudflare 403 challenge to automated fetch and was not read. Its 60/100 figure is from a search snippet only.
Open Advancement (RED update, Thief page): Explorers can switch jobs within their class for mesos.
Night Lord page trivia: if another Explorer on the same world has not reached 4th job, extra quests are needed for 3rd and 4th jobs.
The Warrior, Magician, Bowman and Pirate pages fetched did not carry the same advancement table, so they are not included.

Hermit is the 3rd job on the Night Lord line (Night Lord page). Hermit skills are not described on the GMS pages read.
Claw and Charm weapons. Consumes Throwing Stars; the first star in the Use slot gives an attack boost (Night Lord page).
